headline: Clearer setlists, richer songs, and more expressive conversations.
highlights: Messages, announcements, and revision discussions now share polished reactions with smoother mobile motion.
Quoted replies, mentions, and comment controls are clearer and easier to use across phones and desktops.
Setlist reviews now flag duplicate song proposals and make earlier proposals easier to inspect.
Song selection can preview saved lyrics or chord-chart text without stretching the setup modal.
Song title edits, admin chart imports, and responsive review dialogs are more reliable.
